mentions.name: NimbyDar
mentions.description: This app tracks cancelled renewable developments in the UK and searches for patterns in which locations tend to oppose clean energy and renewable projects.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on the NimbyDar - a tracker for cancelled renewable developments in the UK, attempting to find patterns within which locations tend to hate clean energy and renewable projects.
